title: Scaling Zero-Emission Ocean Freight with ZEMBA
summary: Fund e-methanol in the global container fleet through ZEMBA and claim verified Scope 3 reductions, with no change to carriers, routes or transit times.
body_markdown:
---


Article


Through Flexport, shippers of any size can fund e-methanol, a fuel made from renewable electricity, in the global container fleet and claim the reduction in their Scope 3 (supply chain) emissions, without changing carriers, routes or transit times. It runs through the[Zero Emission Maritime Buyers Alliance (ZEMBA)](https://www.shipzemba.org/) .
